text:
kai: rolling out slice `stable-2026-03-17` to prod now. low-risk config, no schema changes. target window 10:00–10:15 UTC. I’ll keep the canary at 5% for 5m then ramp. please standby for smoke pings.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by @kai — slice stable-2026-03-17 — canary 5% — initiated 10:02 UTC. Logs: https://ci.example.com/build/9876 · ETA ~2m

ria: I’m on smoke checks. watching latency + error-rate in dashboards. will ping here with any anomalies.

sam: I can do quick synthetics against the public endpoints, 10 qps for 60s. will report tail p95/p99.

mike: I’ll watch embeddings pipeline and queue backlog during ramp. if queue > 5k, hold and alert.

ops-sre: metrics subscription set: prod.topline, request.latency.p95, model.kvcache.hits, rollout.errors. alert thresholds: p95 > 800ms or errors > 0.5% will trigger rollback.

kai: canary reached 5% — everything green so far. request.latency.p95 ~ 210ms, error-rate 0.02%. no cf spikes.

ria: quick sanity of chat flow OK. sample token counts look normal. small increase in token generation time (~5%). not worrying but noting.

sam: synthetics done: p95=235ms, p99=420ms. no 5xx. attached output:
```
POST /v1/generate 200 OK
latency ms: [120, 220, 235, 420]
errors: 0
```

mike: embeddings pipeline lag stayed <= 600s. KV cache hit-rate steady at 77%.

ops-sre: I see a tiny bump in GPU mem utilization on node pool-a (+2%) but below threshold. no OOMs.

kai: ramping to 25% at 10:08 UTC. all watches remain green. hold for 5m then to 100% if still clean.

deploy-bot: canary updated — 25% traffic. change: inference timeout reduced from 30s -> 20s in config (opt).

ria: noticed a small number of retried requests (<= 10 in last 3m). logs show transient gRPC pool errors: 
```
rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection reset
```
Possibly due to ephemeral pod restarts.

sam: I ran a targeted rerun for a failing trace pattern; it succeeded on retry. request trace: trace_id=abc123

mike: started rolling quick restart on 2 nodes that reported pod restarts earlier. no increased pod churn expected.

ops-sre: setting a temporary watch: if retries > 50 in 10m, auto-suspend ramp and notify on-call.

kai: agree. manual rollback prepared if retries spike or p95 > 800ms for >2 minutes. rollback cmd (if needed):
```
./deploy rollback --slice stable-2026-03-10 --confirm
```

ria: after ramp to 25% things look stable. token gen time back to baseline. I’ll stay for full ramp.

deploy-bot: ramp to 100% traffic scheduled — initiated at 10:14 UTC.

sam: full-slice run: p95=245ms, p99=460ms, errors 0.03%. load looks distributed evenly.

ops-sre: post-ramp check — no new alerts. overall error-rate remains ~0.03%. marking rollout green.

mike: small config drift note — one node had older docker image tag; I patched and drained it during the ramp. no impact.

kai: thanks all. follow-ups: (1) add the retry trace pattern to the known transient list, (2) brief ops follow-up to check gRPC pool sizing, (3) note the reduced inference timeout change in release notes.

ria: ack. I’ll open a short follow-up ticket and link traces.

sam: left a quick code-review ping for the timeout change PR — @kai please take a look when you have 5 mins.

kai: will review in a bit. good job team :thumbsup: :partyparrot: 

deploy-bot: deploy complete — stable-2026-03-17 fully rolled to prod at 10:15 UTC. summary: duration 13m, incidents 0, manual rollback not used. 

ops-sre: closing watch. will keep an eye for 1h and then clear the post-deploy channel.

mike: leaving a tiny note in postdeploy doc about the node image patch.

ria: final status — green. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
